character_tex: Frenkel-Kac-Wakimoto characters $\chi_{(\lambda;\mu)} = \eta(\tau)^{-2}\sum_{w\in W(A_2)}\epsilon(w)\sum_{\alpha\in Q} q^{|p'(\lambda+\rho)-p\,w(\mu+\rho)+pp'\alpha|^2/2pp'}$, $p'=p+1$, with $\lambda = (\lambda_1,\lambda_2)$ a level-$(p-3)$ and $\mu = (\mu_1,\mu_2)$ a level-$(p-2)$ $SU(3)$ weight in Dynkin labels, $(\lambda;\mu)\sim(\sigma\lambda;\sigma\mu)$ under the $\mathbb{Z}_3$ rotation of affine Dynkin labels; $h = \frac{|p'(\lambda+\rho)-p(\mu+\rho)|^2-|\rho|^2}{2pp'}$. On a self-conjugate field ($\lambda+\rho = a\rho$, $\mu+\rho = b\rho$) the $C$-twined character is $t_{a,b} = \eta(2\tau)^{-1}\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}}\big(q^{(p'a-pb+pp'n)^2/pp'}-q^{(p'a+pb+pp'n)^2/pp'}\big)$ and $\chi^{\pm} = \frac12(\chi\pm t_{a,b})$. Twisted characters (Poisson resummation of $t_{a,b}$): $\mathcal{T}_r = \eta(\tau/2)^{-1}\big(\sum_{x\equiv r\ (pp')}-\sum_{x\equiv r^*\ (pp')}\big)\,q^{x^2/4pp'}$ with $r^*\equiv r$ mod $p$, $r^*\equiv -r$ mod $p'$, of weight $h_r = \frac1{16}+\frac{r^2-4}{4pp'}$; $\mathcal{T}^{\pm}_r$ are its parts with $L_0-h_r$ in $\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathbb{Z}+\frac12$. Here $p = 5$ and $(r,r^*) \in \{(1,11), (2,22), (4,14), (7,17)\}$.
description: Orbifold of $\mathcal{W}_3(5,6)$ by charge conjugation $C: W\to -W$, $(\lambda;\mu)\mapsto(\lambda^*;\mu^*)$ (Dijkgraaf-Vafa-Verlinde-Verlinde 1989). The untwisted sector keeps one copy of each $C$-orbit of terms and the $C$-even parts of the 4 terms on self-conjugate fields ($C = +1$ on their primaries, the only choice whose twisted sector has non-negative integer multiplicities and spins in $\frac12\mathbb{Z}$); the twisted sector $\sum_r|\mathcal{T}_r|^2$ is the Poisson resummation of $Z_{1,C} = \sum|t_{a,b}|^2$, projected to integer spin.
